entries.clue: Stretchy stuff in a pair of braces, or in the red loops that hold mail together.
Sprung metal mouth in the woodwork that clatters when the mail arrives.
Coarse cloth holdall the mail once travelled in, or a sudden dismissal.
Whiskered figure at the North Pole who gets a mountain of children's letters.
Pied car-park sprinter whose rear end never once stops bobbing up and down
Great tower at the heart of a stronghold, the last refuge once the walls were lost
Moorland wader with a long drooping bill and a bubbling, mournful rising cry
First in line when a title and its lands must pass to the next generation
Two riders thundering at each other on opposite sides of a wooden rail
Pinkish woodland crow with a blue flash on the wing and a hoard of buried acorns
Public frame that gripped a cheat by the head and hands for jeering
Smallest dabbling duck on the marsh, the drake's chestnut head slashed with green
